# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']

print(f"Agent: {agent['boundary']}")

# Strategy: move agent to col 51, click blocks one by one, checking agent position
# After each click, if remaining blocks are at agent's column, move agent

# Move agent RIGHT to col 51
for i in range(5):
    action(['RIGHT'])
agent = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
print(f"Agent: {agent['boundary']}")

# Click all green blocks from left to right, skipping those at col 51
for iteration in range(20):
    greens = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    if not greens:
        print("No greens left!")
        break
    
    agent = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    agent_col = sum(pt[1] for pt in agent['boundary'])//len(agent['boundary'])
    
    # Find blocks NOT at agent's column
    safe_greens = []
    for g in greens:
        cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
        cc = sum(cols)//len(cols)
        if cc != agent_col:
            safe_greens.append(g)
    
    if not safe_greens:
        print(f"No safe greens (agent at col {agent_col})")
        # Move agent to a different column
        action(['LEFT'])
        agent = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
        print(f"Agent moved to: {agent['boundary']}")
        continue
    
    # Click the leftmost safe green block
    safe_greens.sort(key=lambda g: (min(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']), min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary'])))
    g = safe_greens[0]
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"Clicking ({cr}, {cc})...")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])
    
    greens_after = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"  -> {len(greens_after)} greens, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("  GAME OVER!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("  LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
